frequency_question: How often does the government agency formally notify final rules within the strict timeframe ordered by the apex court?
membership_rule: Members are cases where the Supreme Court of a major national jurisdiction issues a specific directive with a fixed deadline (under 60 days) for a regulatory body to notify or finalize public health/consumer standards. Excluded are vague advisory opinions or cases without explicit compliance reporting dates.

cases.name: Mandatory Electronic Health Record interoperability standards compliance (2020)
Air quality standard rapid revision mandate (2021)
Food safety labeling fast-track compliance directive (2022)
Pharmaceutical price transparency rule enforcement window (2023)
Hazardous waste transport rule final notification (2024)

coverage_note: 5 named comparative high-court mandated regulatory deadlines; representative sample of administrative compliance under judicial pressure.
known_gaps: Geographic concentration in common-law jurisdictions with active apex court interventions on bureaucratic delays.
validity_reason: Administrative law structures and bureaucratic responsiveness to judicial oversight evolve slowly over multi-year cycles.
